Q: Multithreading becomes much slower than multiprocessing in free-threaded Python A:

This shouldn't be happening. I opened https://github.com/numpy/numpy/issues/30494 to track the scaling bottleneck. I also opened https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/143057 because it looks like the bulk of the bottleneck is in the tracemalloc C API.

Q: Visual Studio 2026 cshtml pages intellisense not working A:

add in _ViewImport.cshtml namespase @using System.Linq

Q: Is it possible to loop a click event A:

Besides the technical mistake you have done it is an XY issue. Click events have nothing to do with looping. A good approach would be to read into event delegation. You shouldn't attach event listeners to every single element but simply use one event listener on the container that checks what element you have clicked on.

Q: MongoError: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:27017 A:

You can run Cmd as administrator and write this command to start the Mongodb service:

net start MongoDB

Or

  1. Press keys Windows + R
  2. Type services.msc and press OK
  3. Wait for open service
  4. Search for mongodb
  5. Right-click on that line and select Start

And reopen MongoDB.
